# stb headers (vendored subset)

Source repository: https://github.com/planetack/stb_image

Upstream commit: `af1a5bc352164740c1cc1354942b1c6b72eacb8a`

Included headers only:

- `stb_image.h`
- `stb_dxt.h`
- `stb_truetype.h`

Used by the Linux Vulkan port (`ww3d2_vulkan`, GDI font stubs, WorldBuilder).
